name: Taebaeg Gamun-ui Salamdeul
source:
Hello, my name is Beacon. I don't have a regular place of residence, but wander from place to place.

I was traveling hard that day when the director of Taebaek Heavy Industries came looking for me. Apparently, the funeral of the chairman of Taebaek Group is about to take place, and he wants me to attend in his son's place and receive the inheritance.

Why did he choose me? Isn't it because I'm capable enough to be recognized by the director of Taebaek Heavy Industries?

Once I get the inheritance, he'll pay me a decent salary. I had no reason to refuse, so I agreed to participate in the funeral.

I ended up spending a week at the chairman's house, and this is the story of what happened during that week.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521910/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你好，我叫比肯。我没有固定住处，总在各地漂泊。

那天，我正辛苦赶路，太白重工的董事找上了我。原来，太白集团会长的葬礼即将举行，他希望我代替他的儿子出席，并领取遗产。

为什么选我？难道不是因为，我能力出众，足以得到太白重工董事的认可吗？

拿到遗产后，他会付给我一笔可观的报酬。我没有理由拒绝，于是答应参加葬礼。

最终，我在会长家住了一周，这就是那一周里发生的故事。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521910/]Steam[/url]]
